review.head: 98329b35b4c36a44885ea211a2f1e95252d44327
review.notes: Gate rerun at head: all checks 0, OK; depcheck 0 problems (no UPWARD/CYCLE); lake env lean Suggested.lean: sorry-only; #check of all 11 theorems matches the README. Sample: all 15 seeded sections checked against cached texts (uncertified/waived sources listed as not verifiable), plus the headline sources (Dusart 2016 8R/8/R misprint confirmed; Buthe 2016/2018; Schoenfeld 1976; CMS; Vanlalngaia; MV via tmeemt-art14). Numerical controls with a sieve to 1e8 confirm the Lean finite-range hypotheses and the corrected thresholds. Blocking: R01 (P1) the Brun-Titchmarsh route via the unweighted H-1+Q^2 large sieve cannot give the constant 2 (k=1, y=1e6: min_Q (y+Q^2)/J(Q)=154578.5 > 144764.8; the weighted sieve gives 136199.4); R02 (P2) Dusart's p_n lower bound, Axler's pi bound and the Trudgian/Axler intervals are declared not statable though they are statable from pointwise inputs like schoenfeld_interval. P3: FKS Theorem 3 misstated; the 4.2 route fails for log x > 1.663e8; arithmetic slips in the 5.4, 2.5 and 1.7 Checks. Nine source errata recorded.
